envelope.title: D-101 · Confirm payment before accepting an order
envelope.body: D-101 is about Easy Checkout: unconfirmed payments are ruled out because Green Basket Stores requires confirmed payment before an order is accepted. This prevents shoppers seeing an order confirmation when the bank has not accepted the payment.
